NOTICE - IP Final Exam
IP Final Exam Structure
Computer-based via NetExam
Duration : 2 hours + 10 mins (to upload the Java source code files to NetExam and submit)
Part 1 - 50% weightage - MCQ
25 MCQ questions
Each question 4 or 5 answer options
Only 1 correct answer
Each MCQ question carries equal marks
No minus marks deducted for wrong MCQ answers
Part 2 - 50% weightage - Write Java Programs
2 questions, hence separate Java source code files needed to be uploaded
Each question carries equal marks (25% weightage each)
NO Internet access allowed
ONLY allowed to access: Notepad , Notepad++ , Microsoft Calculator and Command Prompt (to compile Java codes)
Student MUST UPLOAD .java source code files into NetExam
Upload option provided for each question separately in NetExam
NO .java source code file uploaded into NetExam = ZERO marks
Content from Lecture 1 to 10
